text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't chirp in a place like this. Go home.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! I'm gonna race Brian! I already 
gave her the challenge letter toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The kanji on your challenge letter was 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hanya...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I call raring to go. What 
got into you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo lost to Brian before! It was super, 
super, suuuper frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even so, don't go shooting a challenge 
letter in with an arrow and barging into 
the student council room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds good to me, doesn't it? 
Accepting a rematch, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indomitable perseverance, fighting with 
all one's might... There may well be 
things to learn in striving to reach the 
very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, we did it—!! I'm not totally 
sure what's going on, but let's get right 
to it—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Without even asking what she wanted, 
geez. Guess it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaah!!! Turbo Engine, full 
throttleeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (I thought she was thoughtless, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(This guy's tearing down the track at an 
absurd pace right from the start...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Why? Isn't she afraid? This... this way 
of running is...!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haa, hahee...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh~~!! I lost agaaain~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You've really broken your limiter, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Decon...? Wh-What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong, Turbo? You're running 
at full blast, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Figured as much. You tore past your 
limits. That's some good crazy."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, interesting. ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? Y-You're welcome...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Narita Brian's running 
was honed to be even sharper and more 
ferocious.
